Three sandbox accounts carry the reservation adriatic-summit-2609. sandbox7733 (730184562393) is back: available: true, conan_status clean, "returned to pool 2026-09-27". The other 2 of the 3 are still unavailable, for different reasons.

sandbox7731 (730184562391, GUID x4vbn): its cleanup ran and failed. find_jobs for x4vbn returns the provision 5512840 (successful) and the destroy 5519377 on event0, which failed at 2026-09-26T18:31:48Z. The destroy job's log shows the cluster itself was destroyed, but the task "Delete the sandbox hosted zone" failed with HostedZoneNotEmpty. That is the account's own Route53 zone, Z0718342JX3NQ8PLW5RTA (the same hosted_zone_id as on its account record). Two records the lab created were never removed: grafana-adriatic.sandbox7731.sandbox.example.net and keycloak-adriatic.sandbox7731.sandbox.example.net. The account record agrees: conan_status cleanup-failed. To recover, delete those two record sets (or the zone's leftover records) and rerun the destroy for x4vbn.

sandbox7732 (730184562392, GUID d9kzr): no cleanup job exists. find_jobs for d9kzr returns nothing (total 0) when searched across every controller, so no provision or destroy job with that GUID is on east, west, event0 or partner0. Its record still says conan_status in-use. Nothing has tried to clean it, so there is no failure to diagnose. Either its destroy was never launched, or the account was handed out outside the AAP2 workflow. Someone should check its order in Babylon and launch the destroy for d9kzr.
